candidates.description: This feature vector represents autonomous or semi-autonomous mechanical and artificial beings.
This vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes across Romance languages, primarily forming adverbs of manner and abstract nouns.
This vector represents Spanish nouns denoting organized entities, systems, or projects in both singular and plural forms.
This feature vector represents action verbs and terminology related to utility, usage, and commands in Spanish and English.
These tokens are Spanish verbs representing common everyday actions and states.
Words related to similarity, comparison, and things that are alike or simultaneous.
This feature activates on words and subword tokens starting with the letter sequence "qu" across multiple languages.
This feature activates on common Spanish root words, grammatical suffixes, and lexical fragments.
This feature vector represents prefixes or roots of words related to technology, materials, and physical or digital substances.
This vector represents modal verbs and concepts of possibility, ability, and necessity across multiple languages.
